findings.message: A step found both its source and its destination holding content, and is set aside with the rest of its change. Keep one copy, then run koan repair.
The notes of @5 sit in $HOME/copy/tree/@work/@5.md, and belong in $HOME/copy/tree/@5.md, where notes already are. Keep one copy by hand.
$HOME/copy/tree/@Notes.md is not one of koan's names. koan only reports it: rename it without the @, or move it out.
